bio: Henry Pitts records as an artist under the name Black Lansky — the same Black Lansky who runs Cumulative Web Inc and produces behind the boards. His streaming profiles (Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer) carry the artist name Black Lansky. His artist releases, verified via his Spotify for Artists dashboard on 2026-09-24, include the Focused Intent EP (released Nov 14, 2022; 4,209 all-time Spotify streams), the Sync Ready Tracks EP (58 streams), and the singles tiempo (61), LOFI 2.0 (44), Retro Vibe (17), Skateboard Tea… (10; full title truncated in dashboard screenshot) and Viral Beats (7). His verified producer and co-producer credits across the CWI catalog include That Boy Hi Hat's Diabolique (2026-07-03; produced by Hybrid, co-produced by Black Lansky, recorded at Cue Recording Studio, Arlington VA) and Idol or Icon (with Jeck Da General, with rights owned to the connected tracks); King Akeem's Next Generation Protocol singles; Greg Porn's Pay Yourself and On Edge; Dre50's Pix (lyricist and assistant producer, ℗ 2025 Cumulative Web Inc); and 183 Wildboi's Stunt and Full Moon (Rock-Rap Revival core tracks).
